two-0.reason: Canonical chunk of the two-chunk object

two-1.reason: Canonical chunk of the two-chunk object

forged-duplicate.reason: Same O/index, altered ciphertext, stale HMAC

tag-modified.reason: Damaged discovery tag is not evidence of a foreign object

foreign.reason: Another recovery root, discovery tag does not match

wrong-id-bad-mac.reason: Matching discovery tag for another ID, invalid HMAC must not select that ID

wrong-tag-valid-mac.reason: Discovery mismatch even though the supplied-root MAC verifies

public-kind.reason: Public kind is not a private candidate

post-mac-iv.reason: HMAC verifies; IV or metadata is invalid

post-mac-length-zero.reason: HMAC verifies; IV or metadata is invalid

post-mac-length-overflow.reason: HMAC verifies; IV or metadata is invalid

post-mac-length-count.reason: HMAC verifies; IV or metadata is invalid

post-mac-type.reason: HMAC verifies; IV or metadata is invalid

post-mac-flags.reason: HMAC verifies; IV or metadata is invalid

wrong-id-post-mac-iv.reason: Matching tag and valid HMAC under another ID; invalid semantics must not select that ID

wrong-id-post-mac-length.reason: Matching tag and valid HMAC under another ID; invalid semantics must not select that ID

wrong-id-post-mac-type.reason: Matching tag and valid HMAC under another ID; invalid semantics must not select that ID

wrong-id-post-mac-flags.reason: Matching tag and valid HMAC under another ID; invalid semantics must not select that ID

other-complete.reason: Second complete ID under the supplied root

other-partial.reason: One valid chunk selects a second ID even when incomplete

padding-conflict.reason: Same meaningful bytes and metadata, distinct authenticated padding

type-conflict.reason: Canonical chunk with conflicting content type

length-conflict.reason: Canonical chunk with conflicting L, same N, digest and type

count-conflict.reason: Same O, canonical N=1 conflicts with the N=2 object

digest-conflict.reason: Canonical record carrying a conflicting file digest

final-hash-fail.reason: Fully valid record, final whole-object digest does not match

two-hash-fail-0.reason: All records agree on a digest that fails after full reconstruction

two-hash-fail-1.reason: All records agree on a digest that fails after full reconstruction
